movies.title: Obsidian Horizon
movies.description: When an orbital megastructure around Kepler-186f begins broadcasting a countdown older than human civilization, mission commander Elena Vance descends through volatile atmospheric storms to decode the signal before Earth loses telemetry forever.

movies.title: Aarambham: The Last Sovereign
movies.description: Set along the fortified Deccan plateau of the 14th century, an exiled general unites fractured mountain clans to defend the ancient granite citadel against an overwhelming imperial siege.

movies.title: Midnight in Kyoto
movies.description: A disgraced acoustic forensics specialist is summoned to a rain-drenched Kyoto district after a rare 1968 vinyl master vanishes alongside three witnesses during the autumn lantern festival.

movies.title: Velvet Frequencies
movies.description: Over one winter season inside an underground Mumbai-meets-London jazz room, two rival composers confront past betrayals while recording a live analog album that could save their crumbling venue.

movies.title: Kaveri Express
movies.description: Hurtling across mist-choked Western Ghats viaducts during a cyclonic blackout, a veteran locomotive engineer races to disarm an encrypted cargo heist aboard the overnight Kaveri Express.

movies.title: The Clockmaker's Paradox
movies.description: Inside a subterranean astronomical observatory powered by century-old brass gears, a young horologist discovers an astrolabe that rewinds sixty seconds of reality with every chime.

movies.title: Monsoon Letters
movies.description: Separated for seven monsoons after a coastal ferry accident, a marine cartographer and a tea-house archivist reconnect through unsent letters washed ashore in Alleppey.

movies.title: Apex Circuit
movies.description: An independent motorsport constructor risks bankruptcy and personal rivalry to field a ground-up hybrid prototype at the rain-lashed Singapore midnight street grand prix.

movies.title: Garuda: Skybound
movies.description: A spirited young glider apprentice befriends an ancient clockwork sunbird above floating cloud sanctuaries, embarking on a skyward quest to restore the seasonal trade winds.

movies.title: Silent Meridian
movies.description: Submerged beneath three meters of Arctic pack ice, a nuclear submarine acoustic officer intercepts a ghost vessel transmitting top-secret diplomatic codes from an abandoned 1984 bunker.

movies.title: Karavali: The Coastal Storm
movies.description: Along the windswept fishing harbours of coastal Karnataka, a fearless boatman confronts an illicit port syndicate during the fierce Karavali monsoon to protect his ancestral village.

movies.title: Bengaluru Midnight
movies.description: During a rain-swept blackout across Indiranagar and MG Road, an investigative radio host follows five encrypted voice notes left inside a vintage car to uncover a decade-old disappearance.
